originalPeerDecision.title: Auftrieb an Tragflächen und Luftwiderstand qualitativ einordnen

requiredCaseWork.independentResolution: For an oblique flow direction (-3,-4), a drag arrow follows that direction and a lift direction (-4,3) has zero dot product with it. The side mark chooses the appropriate perpendicular sense. This coordinate check is reviewer work, not a learner prerequisite.
A wind-tunnel wing has flow-related dynamic lift and drag. A balloon in still air instead has Archimedean buoyancy. The same upward direction does not establish the same cause.

originalPeerDecision.wholeMathConclusion: Approve the entire unchanged 2231 relational competence: classify parallel/perpendicular supporting directions, use the corresponding language, and justify invariance under rotation/translation. Physics independently produces the force arrows from its newly learned force/flow rule. The P supplies flow and the upper-side mark, not finished forces; no compass procedure, equal-distance proof or arbitrary reflex-angle task is required.
nextActions: Prepare a separate exact add proposal retaining e11b and appending 2231; verify the actual candidate binding and all independently required admission/native quality gates. This packet changes no Root state.
originalPeerDecision.authorComparison: The new author case work is consistent with the independent first pass. This is a fresh judgment, not a count of historical votes.

originalPeerDecision.constructionDissentResolution: Earlier peer dissent expressly allowed construction to be learned inside Physics if the author justified that boundary. The new author now does so without changing P: independent diagram production remains mandatory, while a set-square protocol or compass proof is not. The complete Math2231 supporting-line and orientation reasoning is necessary relational preparation, not a claim that recognition alone is a construction course.

These do not constitute a quoted nationwide source mandate for the edge: this acceptance is didactic sequencing of the exact current canonical Goal/P.
